title.narrative: Accelerating TB case notification in Lagos State - Nigeria (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Nigeria, Tuberculosis, Lagos State Ministry of Health (LSMOH)This program has the following goals: To accelerate efforts at ending TB epidemic in Nigeria by ensuring access to comprehensive and high quality patients' centered and community owned TB (TB. TB/HIV and DR-TB) services for all Nigerians by 2025. The objectives of this program are: To increase case notification rate of all forms of TB from 60/100,000 population in 2019 to 153/100,000 population in 2023. To increase TB treatment success rate from 87% in 2019 to 90% in 2023 among drug susceptible patients. To enrol 100% of diagnosed DR-TB patients on appropriate treatment by 2023
